tags.description: White marble shark sculpture at about 8m depth off Guvercin Ada (Pigeon Island), Kas. Sources describe it as left over from past underwater art exhibitions. Old scattered wooden wreck at ~22m, sheet-metal artificial-reef wreck at ~28m, deep reef with broken amphorae. PADI lists max depth 30m; Nautilus Diving Kas describes ~28m.
tags.name: Shark Sculpture
Uçak Batığı
tags.historic_period: Douglas C-47A Dakota of the Turkish Air Force (decommissioned), scuttled 2008 (one source: 2007)
tags.description: Ex-Turkish Air Force Douglas C-47A Dakota (length 19-19.6m, wingspan ~29m, per Sualtı Gazetesi and Zentacle), sunk deliberately by BOSAD as an artificial reef off Karaada/Pacoz near Bodrum on 1 July 2008 (The Divers' Club gives 2007). Split in two in 2010; sections lie ~16-23m (engine/cockpit) and ~28-34m (fuselage/tail). Source depth ranges conflict (max ~25m to ~34m).

tags.name: Büyük Resif
tags.description: Big Reef between Bodrum Peninsula and Karaada (Black Island). Wall facing Karaada drops from ~7m (summit ~5m per The Divers' Club) to 34m. Divers' Club reports strong currents and recommends experienced divers.

tags.name: Aksona
tags.description: Aksona Point, ~50 min by boat from Bodrum beyond Karaada, named for sponge hunter Aksona Mehmet. Starts at 3m, slopes through the 20s to a rock wall at 30-35m. Phoenician ship anchor reported at 13.5m on a flat rock; near-complete amphora on sand at ~30m.
